bids.rationale: We are bidding 65 for 1,000 impressions, promising 5 signups per 1,000, which is well below our past rate of 8 to 9. The price gives a fair margin over cost and the reference price without chasing the lowest bid.

Quote promises 7 signups per 1,000 impressions, within our past 6 to 8 conversion range, so delivery risk is moderate. Price per promised signup ranks well against the reference and leaves a middling margin.

We are bidding on 1,000 impressions at a price of 60 with a conservative promise of 10 signups per 1,000, which we think we can meet. The promise is kept at the gate minimum so that a shortfall does not put our bond at risk.
We bid a small, low quote to test for a spare slot, promising only what our audience reliably delivers. The estimate tool passed this quote with a healthy expected margin.
